intro: APT33, CL-STA-1062, and CyberAv3ngers were the most frequently cited threat actors across the 28 articles on this tag, published between April 12 and August 8, 2026. Coverage centered on CVE-2026-24032, rated 7.3 on the CVSS scale, with energy, government, and utilities sectors most affected. Reporting spanned the United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other global regions. The archive includes 15 high-severity incidents, 3 critical, 3 informational, and 1 medium, reflecting a broad range of activity against critical infrastructure.
